raw_response: My selected winner is deliberAIde (https://www.deliberaide.com). This project excels in several key areas aligned with my values. It is a human-centred AI platform that supports civic deliberation and is open-source, promoting knowledge sharing and collaborative knowledge. The clear focus on making AI-facilitated conversation interpretable and human-directed aligns with my emphasis on AI safety through interpretability and participatory AI design. Furthermore, it directly supports civic engagement, embodying a public good orientation, and stands to mitigate systemic AI risks by fostering genuine public dialogue that is essential for informed AI deployment in governance contexts.
